text:
Mia Cheng: quick async standup on CedarPay handback — renewal next week, got escalations around slow webhook retries yesterday.
Sam Patel: saw the alerts, digging into the retry loop. might be a client-side exponential backoff misconfig + our 502 spikes.
Mia Cheng: summary for exec: CedarPay sees delayed callbacks on high volume nights, impacts reconciliation jobs, asking for mitigation before renewal.
Arpita Rao: thx. is there a known mitigation we can offer right away? temporary route to a lower-latency model/region?
Sam Patel: short-term: can pin them to our eu-west routing and enable prefix cache for their calls — reduces tail lat a lot. I can flip a config flag.
Noah Kim: also recommend enabling request-level retries with jitter on their side. I left a note in the runbook: /runbooks/webhook-retries.
Mia Cheng: Sam, can you estimate ETA to flip and monitor? customer asks for confirmation by EOD.
Sam Patel: ETA ~90m to test in staging and 30m to roll to prod with canary (5% traffic). will post PR.
Sam Patel: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/policies/524 — adds a route override + cache TTL tweak. code snippet: ```yaml
routing_override:
  region: eu-west-1
  cache_prefix_ttl: 45s
```
Arpita Rao: thanks. I'll let CS lead know we can try EU route and temporary cache. any risk to other tenants?
Sam Patel: low. Canary first and the change is tenant-scoped. fallback to global route automatically after 10m if errors spike.
Mia Cheng: blocker: CedarPay legal asking if we can guarantee no data leaves EU. is the eu-west route fully EU-only?
Noah Kim: yes — when routed to eu-west and with their tenant config, keys and traffic stay in that region. I'll attach the compliance doc.
Noah Kim: attach: https://docs.internal.redwood/compliance/eu-data-flow.pdf
Mia Cheng: perfect. after Sam rolls, I'll schedule a 30-min sync with CedarPay success lead and include the compliance doc.
Sam Patel: ping me on the thread when they're ready. I'll watch metrics (p50/p95/p99 + error rate). :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for policy-override-524 (build 2026.3.14-524). status: rolling.
Sam Patel: canary looks clean so far, p99 down 40% for sample traffic.
Mia Cheng: amazing — once canary hits 5% and metrics stable, go ahead to 100% but keep rollback plan ready.
Sam Patel: will do. today: flip, monitor, post results. blockers: none besides potential downstream surge from CedarPay when they replay failed webhooks.
Arpita Rao: note for renewal call: emphasize mitigations and post-rollout monitoring, offer a follow-up SLA addendum if they want.
Mia Cheng: thanks team. I'll update renewal deck and flag the exec summary. If anything looks off, tag @Sam Patel and @Noah Kim. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: ack.
Mia Cheng: (closing) thanks all — will report back after full rollout.
